blocks.text: Using several security tools and practices together protects personal information: spam filters, antivirus software, cookie management, recognizing phishing and guarding against pharming.

blocks.prompt: Why combine several protections instead of relying on one?
blocks.explanation: Each tool covers different threats; for example an antivirus does not stop a phishing email that tricks you into typing your password.

items: Prevention: spam filters, antivirus, cookie management, spotting phishing, guarding against pharming, used together.
